name: Entrance Foyer
description: The space is barely lit, a small crack in the wall paneling allows a sliver of sunshine to illuminate the dusty, rotted interior of this foyer. You see a boxed shoe rack, scraps of leather spilling from it and a small candle resting on top.

actions.name: look
actions.description: The light catches the bronze of the candle's holder, it is fashioned with a ring, for roaming halls late at night.

actions.name: ignite
actions.description: You strike a match and hold it up to the wick. The candle lights.
